page.layout: One column of index lines on the left, with page numbers at the right of each entry. The right side of the page is not part of this transcription.; Two columns of index entries. Left column, lower part: "Apollinis templum" to "Apollonius. 91. grammaticus. 92". Right column, from the top to the foot: "Apollonij doctrina" to "Argus. 42", then the catchword "drie-" at the bottom right.

main_text.l: aquilæ pullos à Phana nu triri 13z. cogi solem intueri. ibid.

page.notes: The first line of the index is partly hidden at the top, and the title "INDEX" is cut through at its right end. The word "furcs" and the word "cultius" look like printing errors, copied as printed. The line "Ambracio / tas" shows no printed hyphen, so it is written whole. The numerals written "z" (4z, 15z, 21z, 13z, 11o) are the old printed forms of 2, and "o" for 0 in 11o, as printed. "Phana nu triri" is set with a space and may be a printing break; read with [?] not applied as the letters are clear. Possible running title or catchword fragment at the bottom right is the catchword only.
